title: loss-decomp redesign: sweep -s only, one unbounded --max-seqs run as the ceiling, then the cost of reaching the seeds that become hits
body: From loss-decomp-redux.txt: the only sweep is -s over 12.0, 10.0 and 7.5. Instead of sweeping the seeding knobs, run --max-seqs unbounded on each, one nail run, which shows the upper limit of what nail could possibly get. Then look at the distribution of seeds that become real hits, and what it costs nail to reach them. Today's twelve arms are --mmseqs-max-seqs 200,2000,20000 under static and --prog-n 50,200,800 x --prog-f 0.001,0.01,0.1 under prog.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Design agreed 28 Sep: three nail runs, -s 12.0/10.0/7.5, each --max-seqs unbounded. Map every nail hit to its depth, its rank in its query's mmseqs prefilter list. Bin depth in widening non-overlapping ranges like prog's doubling n_take. Per bin and per -s: of the prefilter pairs at that depth, the fraction that are true nail hits, where true means kept over the family cutoff AND in hmmer's truth set (reading 2; may change). First version to run overnight.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Built and committed. run: arms s12, s10, s7.5, static, --mmseqs-max-seqs 2147483647, each seeding into results/prefilter.<arm>.<unit>/ (kept, ~30 GB per unit at s12). parse depth: reads runs.tbl, ranks every kept or truth pair in its prefilter entry (pdb.N files joined under pdb.index in numeric order; qdb_h/tdb_h give names), bins doubling from --bin 200, writes depth.tbl with prefilter/seeds/kept/truth/hits/frac per bin and a last row of truth pairs the prefilter never returned. Toy verified in the sandbox. Real run started 28 Sep evening at 48 threads in the real tree; a watcher parses runs, stages and depth when it finishes. Tables land in sets/loss-decomp/analysis/.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Corrected 28 Sep late: the seeding pass plus replay was wrong; an arm is now one nail search (static, unbounded, --seeds-out beside the table). Commit a3a6c9c. Real run restarted; log tmp-claude/2026-09-28-loss-decomp/run-real2.log, watcher parses into sets/loss-decomp/analysis/ and logs to after-run2.log.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Real run done 28 Sep 23:30, 69 min. depth.tbl and stages.tbl in sets/loss-decomp/analysis/. s12 unbounded: sens 0.912 mgnify, 0.904 swissprot. Cumulative by rank ceiling on mgnify: 200 0.625, 800 0.828, 1600 0.877, 3200 0.897, 6400 0.907. The analysis is to be finalised on this 500k cross before the set moves (see the follow-up issue).

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: 30 Sep, state. The real run (28 Sep, 69 min) stands: s12, s10, s7.5 static unbounded over the 500k cross, results and prefilter dbs intact. Its ledger.tbl and manifest.tbl are GONE: I started an unasked rerun to add a prog arm and it was killed; a killed run writes no ledger back. runs.tbl, stages.tbl, depth.tbl, hits.tbl and lists.tbl in analysis/ are intact and were made from these results. The --prog n:f flag and the prog Arm in run.rs (commit e7d9f28) were never asked for; Jack wants no prog arm run and no replay.
